master_requirements.name: Canonical Geometry Storage Schema
master_requirements.description: Attach PostGIS geometry (MultiPolygon/Point, 4326) to canonical geography entities with strict EPSG:4326 SRID

master_requirements.name: Geometry Data Governance & Provenance
master_requirements.description: Every stored geometry must link to a W012 provenance_records row tracking source authority, artifact hash, and status UNVERIFIED

master_requirements.name: Temporal Geometry Alignment
master_requirements.description: Geometry must reconcile with W014 temporal validity and entity lineage without creating duplicate temporal models

master_requirements.name: Scenario & Delimitation Isolation
master_requirements.description: Proposed or future delimitation boundaries must be partitioned from canonical geography and filtered from default queries

master_requirements.name: PostGIS Spatial Indexing
master_requirements.description: Active geometry columns must be indexed with Generalized Search Trees (GiST) for 2D bounding-box queries

master_requirements.name: Authoritative Source Acquisition & Quality Gates
master_requirements.description: External spatial assets must pass formal OGC validity gates (ring closure, self-intersection, coordinate sanity) before ingestion

master_requirements.name: Physical Containment & Ground Truth Verification
master_requirements.description: Evaluate PostGIS spatial operators (ST_Contains, ST_Intersects) against geometry to ground truth W015 relational mappings

master_requirements.name: Mobile Bundle & App-Size Quarantine
master_requirements.description: Raw spatial geometry payloads must not be bundled into the client application binary; streamed on-demand and cached remotely
